description:
For struggling idol Hana, a late-night variety show invitation feels like a golden opportunity. Sure, the program is infamous for its over-the-top content, but exposure is exposure... Right? With cameras and staff all around, what’s the worst that could happen? The answer comes fast and shocking. The hosts and fellow guests clearly didn’t get the memo about “professional boundaries.” Suddenly, the games and skits spiral into outrageous territory, the kind of risqué chaos no public broadcast should ever attempt. Hana can only stare in disbelief as the so-called “entertainment” blurs every line between performance and scandal. Is this still a variety show or some twisted after-hours experiment? And most importantly, are the cameras really rolling right now?!Between shock, embarrassment, and unintended hilarity, Hana is caught in the most unpredictable “broadcast” of her life. One thing’s certain: this is late-night TV like no one ever imagined.

(Source: Lezhin US)
